clauses.title: Chemical Requirements
clauses.content: Maximum carbon content shall be 0.30% for Fe 415, 0.25% for Fe 500D; sulphur and phosphorus shall not exceed 0.040% each for D grades.

clauses.title: Mechanical Properties
clauses.content: Proof stress (0.2%) min 500 N/mm² for Fe 500D, tensile strength min 565 N/mm², elongation min 16.0%, and total elongation at max force min 5%.

qco.title: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2020
qco.product: High strength deformed steel bars and wires for concrete reinforcement
qco.scope: Mandatory ISI mark certification under Ministry of Steel Order S.O. 2452(E). Conformance to IS 1786 is compulsory for manufacturing, import, and commercial sale in India.
requirements: Mandatory BIS Licence (ISI Mark) under IS 1786.
Strict adherence to chemical limits (carbon, sulphur, phosphorus) and bend/rebend tests.
